scope: Prospective small-fixture paired comparison of direct real reviewer dispatch guidance. Not a general autonomy guarantee.
earlyStop: After two pairs, stop for futility if candidate median time and processed tokens are both no better; stop on quality or execution failure and investigate without discarding the failed trial.
acceptance: All quality oracles, independent review, in-Host verification and Draft CI pass; complete participant usage; both medians improve; no worse maxima per existing paired acceptance. All attempts retained.
hypothesis: Role/type clarification avoids unsupported or placeholder reviewer launches; added prompt length must not worsen small-task total cost.
